extracted.intended_audience: members of the public (requesters) seeking federal records or considering filing a FOIA request
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for members of the public on whether to file a Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) request and how to prepare and submit it to the correct federal agency. Covers preparatory research, agency selection, and what to expect after submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Determine whether FOIA is the right option
rubrics_metrics.description: Do research and determine if you need to make a FOIA request before proceeding.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The site can help you determine if filing a FOIA request is the best option for you and help you create your request when you’re ready. Do research before you request; first see if the information is already publicly available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search public sources before requesting
rubrics_metrics.description: Check individual agency websites and cross-government search tools to see if the desired information is already publicly available.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: You can find a lot of useful information on individual agency websites and you can also search across the government for information. Use our search tool to find public records or the correct agency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identify the correct agency to receive your request
rubrics_metrics.description: Make sure you direct your FOIA request to the federal agency that holds the records you want, because each agency handles its own FOIA requests.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: There are over 100 agencies and each is responsible for handling its own FOIA requests. You can use our search tool to help you identify the correct place to find the information you seek.

rubrics_metrics.name: Understand how agencies will process your request (search and review)
rubrics_metrics.description: After submission, the agency will typically search for responsive records and then review them to determine what can be disclosed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The agency will typically first search for the records and then review them to determine what can be disclosed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Know the FOIA exemptions that may limit disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Be aware that FOIA contains nine exemptions that protect certain types of information from release, affecting what the agency can disclose.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: While FOIA allows for many records to be released, there are also nine exemptions that protect certain types of information, such as personal privacy and law enforcement interests.

rubrics_metrics.name: Anticipate variable response times based on complexity and backlog
rubrics_metrics.description: Expect that how long an agency takes to respond depends on the complexity of your request and the agency's backlog of requests.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The length of time to respond to your request will vary depending on its complexity and any backlog of requests.
